description: Exporter side (design sections 3.1-3.4, 11; review NIT 2 = OD2; OD1 cortex ids). New label set `synthfine` (= the 103-id SynthSeg --parc remap, same map/names as `synthseg`) exported at levels 1/2/4 with NESTED majority downsampling so that LUT(synthfine_k) == train18_k voxel for voxel; `export-check` verifies it; add-only `python -m preprocessing export-add-labels` (phase files: per-case npy only, verified against the existing train18 files before any write; phase manifest: pre-check, re-check, backup, append-only edit of the six label columns in parts + manifest + luts, merge reproduction, diff check with restore) driven by export_manifest.csv; SLURM array wrapper for the basic partition. Pure numpy/stdlib, TF-free; independent of the other features (FEAT-002 imports the new luts helpers).
steps: preprocessing/luts.py: add `LUTS["synthfine"] = _build(_synthseg_entries(), "SynthSeg 2.0 --parc ids, contiguous (synthfine: train18-consistent nested downsampling)")` (identical map/names to synthseg). Add `synthfine_to_train18_table() -> np.ndarray` uint8 [256]: entry k = train18 id of the raw id o with LUTS['synthfine']['map'][o] == k (from LUTS['train18']['map']), entries 103..255 = 0. Add `CORTEX_TRAIN18_ID = 2` and `synthfine_cortex_ids() -> np.ndarray` (sorted int64 ids k < 103 with table[k] == 2; expected {2, 20} U {33..102}, 72 ids). Document both in the module docstring (synthfine entry + the cortical id list and why: OD1, tau/amyloid regional cortex variation). Pure numpy, py3.8 typing.

preprocessing/export.py: `SYNTHSEG_SETS = ("train18", "synthseg", "synthfine")`, `LABEL_SET_LEVELS["synthfine"] = (1, 2, 4)`. New `nested_block_mode(fine, k, table, what="labels")` exactly as design 3.2 (vectorised like block_mode: block view b [B, k^3]; counts = np.bincount(b_idx * 103 + f, minlength=B*103) reshaped [B, 103], cast to int16 immediately and the int64 array deleted; parent counts pc[B, 19] = sum of counts over fine ids of each class (loop over 19 classes or one matmul on a [103, 19] 0/1 int16 matrix with int32 accumulation); c* = argmax pc (ties smallest); f* = argmax of np.where(table[:103][None, :] == c*[:, None], counts, -1) (ties smallest); return uint8 reshaped). Validate: integer dtype, non-negative, max <= 102 (ValueError), divisible shape (`_check_divisible`). New `synthfine_level(fine_full, k)` = fine_full if k == 1 else nested_block_mode(fine_full, k, synthfine_to_train18_table()). In export_npy's per-set loop use `synthfine_level` for ls == 'synthfine' at k > 1 (block_mode stays for every other set). Update the module docstring (labels paragraph: synthfine at 1,2,4, nested vote). Leave `_needs_write` / `_write_items` unchanged.

preprocessing/export.py `export_check`: for every checked row that lists `synthfine` at a level whose train18 file is also listed: load both, require dtype uint8, max(synthfine) <= 102 and `table[synthfine_k] == train18_k` everywhere; failures appended to `problems` as '<case>: labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy inconsistent with labels_train18<sfx>.npy at level k (<n> voxels differ)' (exit 1 through the CLI as today).

preprocessing/add_labels.py (new module, docstring = design 3.3 summary incl. the range rule): `LABEL_COLUMNS = ("labels", "label_dtypes", "label_levels") + tuple("labels_l%d" % k for k in export.ALL_LEVELS)`; `SUPPORTED_SETS = ("synthfine",)`; `STATUS_DIR = "add_labels"`. `resolve_range(n_rows, start, end)` implementing OD2 (None start -> 0, None end -> n_rows; negative or start > end -> ValueError (CLI exit 2); end clipped to n_rows; start >= n_rows -> empty). `add_labels_files(out_root, export_root, label_set="synthfine", start=None, end=None) -> (status_dict, exit_code)` = design 3.3 phase files steps 1-5 exactly (source `<out_root>/<dataset>/<subject_dir>/labels_synthseg.nii.gz`; npy dir `<export_root>/<dataset>/<subject_dir>`, npy_dir column only compared + WARNING; `nifti.load_data(src, np.float64)[0]` + `apply_lut(..., LUTS['synthfine'], 'uint8', what=...)`; shape vs `shape_l1`; per level of `levels`: f_k, verify against the train18 file named in `labels_l<k>` BEFORE any write; `_npy_state` handling missing/unreadable -> write with `_atomic_save_npy`, ok -> bit-equality check (kept or failed), mismatch -> failed; per-case try/except so one case never stops the chunk; status JSON `<export_root>/add_labels/<set>/rows-<start>-<end|'end'>.json` written atomically with per-case {case, status: written|kept|failed, reason, levels} and counts; exit 0 iff no failure; failures listed on stdout). `add_set(row, label_set)` = design 3.3 manifest step 3 (append `;synthfine`, `;synthfine:uint8`, `;synthfine:<levels comma list>`, `;labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy` per level; idempotent when `labels` already lists the set; empty column -> no leading ';'). `add_labels_manifest(export_root, label_set)` = steps 0-6: (0) read-only pre-check: copy manifest_parts/ to a temp root (tempfile.mkdtemp under $TMPDIR or `<export_root>/add_labels/tmp_merge_pre`), `merge_parts(tmp)`, byte-compare with export_manifest.csv; on mismatch exit 1 with 'pre-existing divergence between manifest_parts and export_manifest.csv (not caused by export-add-labels)' + differing (dataset, subject_dir) keys, nothing changed, no backup; (1) re-check every row (files exist, uint8, level shape, table consistency) else exit 1 unchanged; (2) backup (copy) export_manifest.csv, label_luts.json, manifest_parts/ to `<export_root>/backup_pre_<set>_<UTC %Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ>/`; (3) transform rows of every part (only rows whose key is in the manifest) and of the manifest, column/row order unchanged (write with `_csv_text(rows, MANIFEST_COLUMNS)`; preserve the part's own column list if it is OLD_MANIFEST_COLUMNS); (4) add `lut_json(LUTS[set])` to `luts` of every transformed part luts.json and label_luts.json (sorted keys, json.dumps indent=2 like merge_parts); (5) merge the transformed parts in a temp root and require byte equality with the transformed manifest, then write parts/luts/manifest atomically; (6) diff check old vs new (only LABEL_COLUMNS differ, new = old + appended entries, same row count/order) written to `add_labels/<set>/manifest_diff.json` and printed; any failure after (2) -> restore every file from the backup and exit 1. Keep functions small and testable; log with `logging.getLogger(__name__)`.

preprocessing/cli.py: register `export-add-labels` (help + description = add_labels docstring): `--out-root` (required for phase files), `--export-root` (required), `--label-set` (default synthfine; anything not in SUPPORTED_SETS -> exit 2 with a message), `--phase` choices files|manifest (required), `--start`/`--end` (int, files only; with manifest -> exit 2). `cmd_export_add_labels` maps ValueError from resolve_range to exit 2, returns the function's exit code; add to COMMANDS and the module docstring command list. preprocessing/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add export-add-labels to the `--help` loop.

preprocessing/slurm/add_labels_array.sh (new, LF, header style of export_array.sh): `#SBATCH --job-name=bgr_add_labels`, `--partition=basic`, `--account=qtim`, `##SBATCH --qos=PLACEHOLDER_QOS`, `--nodes=1`, `--ntasks-per-node=1`, `--time=02:00:00`, `--mem=8G`, `--cpus-per-task=1`, `--array=0-0%2`, `--output`/`--error` `$PROJ/logs/%x_%A_%a.out|.err`; usage comment with the exact commands of plan.md FINAL REPORT (a) (every usage sbatch --array line ends in %2). Body: `set -euo pipefail`; PROJ/REPO_DIR/OUT_ROOT ($PROJ/data/processed)/EXPORT_ROOT ($PROJ/data/npy_v2) defaults; `PHASE=${PHASE:-files}` (files|manifest|check), `CHUNK=${CHUNK:-500}` (positive integer), `LABEL_SET=${LABEL_SET:-synthfine}`; invalid PHASE/CHUNK -> echo ERROR, exit 2 before any work; `export USE_GPU=${USE_GPU:-0}`, `export BGR_REPO_DIR="$REPO_DIR"`, `RIC=(bash "$REPO_DIR/preprocessing/run_in_container.sh")`, `cd "$REPO_DIR"`; files: TASK=${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:-0}, START=$((TASK * CHUNK)), END=$((START + CHUNK)), `"${RIC[@]}" export-add-labels --out-root "$OUT_ROOT" --export-root "$EXPORT_ROOT" --label-set "$LABEL_SET" --phase files --start "$START" --end "$END"`; manifest: `"${RIC[@]}" export-add-labels --export-root "$EXPORT_ROOT" --label-set "$LABEL_SET" --phase manifest` (array index ignored); check: `"${RIC[@]}" export-check --export-root "$EXPORT_ROOT" --sample 0`; echo status, exit with the command's status.

Tests: new preprocessing/tests/test_add_labels.py (pytest, tmp_path) building a tiny fake tree with the existing helpers pattern of test_export.py (`_subject` with ds='lumir', SHAPE (8,12,16) divisible by 4; use an id set that includes cortex parcels so nested != plain mode is exercised): export train18-only via export_npy in TWO chunks (rows=[0,1] / [2]) -> two parts -> merge_parts; then cover every case of design 7.1 for add_labels: files phase writes exactly labels_synthfine{,_2,_4}.npy per case and leaves every other file's bytes AND mtime unchanged; LUT(synthfine_k) == train18_k at 1/2/4; rerun -> all 'kept'; a case whose labels_synthseg.nii.gz differs from the one used for train18 FAILS with nothing written; a pre-existing wrong labels_synthfine_2.npy FAILS and is left alone; wrong dtype file -> failed; missing source -> failed (others continue, exit 1); range rule (OD2): end beyond rows clipped (last chunk shorter), start >= rows -> 0-case status file + exit 0, negative / start > end -> exit 2 via cli.main, status file name rows-<start>-<end>.json; manifest phase: only LABEL_COLUMNS change (old + appended), row/column order unchanged, idempotent second run, backup dir created with the three items, export-merge afterwards reproduces the new manifest byte for byte, `data_loading.data_module.manifest_files(rows, k, kind='labels', label_set='synthfine')` and the default train18 lookup both work (data_module imports TF at module level: if so, reimplement the name lookup check locally instead of importing it in bgr_preproc38 - check first); refuses (exit 1, no change, no backup) while a case lacks a file; hand-edited export_manifest.csv npy_dir -> exit 1 with 'pre-existing divergence' naming that key, all files byte-identical, no backup; restore path: monkeypatch `add_labels.add_set` (or the diff check) to corrupt a non-label column after the backup -> exit 1 and every file restored byte-identical from the backup; unknown --label-set and --start with --phase manifest exit 2. Extend preprocessing/tests/test_export.py: nested_block_mode property on random arrays (k 2 and 4) and on an adversarial fragmented-cortex block (the design 3.2 8-voxel example: train18 cortex wins, fine winner is a cortex parcel), tie rules (class tie -> smallest class, parcel tie -> smallest fine id), equality `table[nested] == block_mode(table[fine])`; export-npy with label_sets 'train18,synthfine' writes synthfine at 1/2/4 (manifest label_levels 'train18:1,2,4;synthfine:1,2,4') and train18 files byte-identical to a train18-only export; export-check reports a hand-corrupted labels_synthfine_4.npy; luts tests for synthfine_to_train18_table (103 entries vs train18 map, >= 103 zero) and synthfine_cortex_ids == {2, 20} U range(33, 103). Extend preprocessing/tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: add add_labels_array.sh to test_found_scripts' set and USE_GPU toggle list, a policy test like test_export_array_policy (basic, qtim, no GPU, %2 header and usage lines, mem <= 15 GB/CPU, PHASE/CHUNK/LABEL_SET defaults) and an argv stub test (like `_export_argv`) for files (task 2 -> --start 1000 --end 1500 with CHUNK default 500), manifest (no --start/--end) and check phases, plus invalid PHASE/CHUNK -> exit 2.
